$comment: Trusted receiver signer policy, read from the PR base ref only. Evidence must carry a GitHub artifact attestation produced by exactly this pinned, privileged workflow identity, triggered from exactly this source ref (gh attestation verify --signer-workflow --predicate-type --source-ref). check_signer() additionally recomputes the subject digest itself and compares the signed predicate's own fields to expectedPredicate -- a bare verify exit code is never treated as sufficient. This authenticates that the exact CI assessment recorded by receiver-attest.yml (structural integrity + factory allowlist + capability revocation, see assess_canonical) was produced and approved by that pinned workflow -- not that a local agent's execution or any particular SLSA security level is retroactively certified.
